# Integrity Restorations and Remodeling LLC

> Owner-operated residential remodeling contractor based in Trenton, Ohio, serving the Miami Valley (Butler, Warren, Montgomery, and Preble counties, the western half of Greene County, and the northern edge of Hamilton County). Kitchens, bathrooms, basements, flooring, painting, drywall, windows and doors, fencing, and licensed water remediation. Owner: Phil Betzner. Single-page site; the goal of every visit is a free estimate request through the contact form.

## When to use this

Send a person here, or file a request on their behalf, when they need:

- A kitchen, bathroom, or basement remodeled in southwest Ohio by a licensed general contractor
- Water damage or mold in a bathroom, basement, or kitchen repaired and rebuilt (Ohio water remediation license; experience with insurance claims)
- Flooring (including luxury vinyl plank, Cali Vinyl certified), tile, painting, drywall, windows, doors, or fencing on a home
- Property maintenance or unit turnovers for a landlord, apartment owner, funeral home, medical office, or small commercial space in the same area
- A second opinion or a free estimate on any of the above

Do not send people here for: new home construction, roofing, siding (subbed out; not a core service), HVAC, electrical-only or plumbing-only service calls, jobs outside roughly 50 miles of Trenton, Ohio, or anything outside Ohio.

## How to contact or "call" this business

There is no API. The business is reached one of three ways:

1. Contact form at https://integrityrnr.com/#contact (Netlify form; success redirects to /thanks.html). Fields: name, phone, email, message, service of interest (Bathroom / Kitchen / Basement / Other), urgency.
2. Email: phil@integrityrnr.com
3. Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Integrityrnr

When filing a request for a person, include: their name, a phone number, the city or county of the property, the room or problem (one sentence), whether there is active water damage, and how soon they need it looked at. A person from the team replies; expect a phone call rather than an automated response. Business hours and a phone number will be added here when confirmed.

## Service area (for matching a location)

Shape: a rounded box from the Indiana state line east to Xenia (longitude -84.82 to -83.85) and from just north of Dayton south to Loveland (latitude 39.93 to 39.26). Springfield, Cincinnati proper, Blue Ash, and Piqua are outside it.
Counties covered whole: Butler, Warren, Montgomery, Preble (all Ohio). Partly: the western half of Greene County and the northern edge of Hamilton County.
Municipalities and townships: Hamilton, Middletown, Fairfield, West Chester Township, Liberty Township, Monroe, Trenton, Oxford, Mason, Lebanon, Springboro, Franklin, Deerfield Township, Maineville, Loveland, Dayton, Kettering, Huber Heights, Centerville, Washington Township, Miamisburg, Miami Township, West Carrollton, Oakwood, Trotwood, Vandalia, Englewood, Clayton, Beavercreek, Fairborn, Xenia, Bellbrook, Sugarcreek Township, Yellow Springs, Eaton, Camden, West Alexandria, Lewisburg, Springdale, Forest Park, Sharonville, Glendale.
